notes: This is an upright handwritten text leaf with three numbered remarks, own page number 14 and separate thin foliation 36. The principal prose occupies 24 baseline lines; insertions and the second union-bound row are additional to that count.

Remark 1 says that suitable non-wildness hypotheses on the initial data should imply the existence of a conic structure. It further expects an equisingular conic structure when the stratification is equisingular along the written open strata, reducing the construction to an equisingular tube around X_{I_0}. This is a report of the manuscript, not a verified existence theorem.

The open-stratum definition visibly contains both j<i and j≤i in stacked lower rows. Neither row is struck. Their intended status as simultaneous conditions or as a revision is not settled by the ink, and neither is silently removed.
The definition label is unaccented def. The verbal = after il doit is explicit and is retained as written; même is only its likely expansion in the abbreviation list.

Remark 2 proposes a recursive definition along a strictly increasing filtration in which each new layer consists of minimal elements of the remaining ordered set, then asserts essential independence from the chosen filtration. No proof or independent verification of that assertion was performed by this reader.

The filtration’s final indices are n-1 and n. The final digit in n-1 is compressed and the decision has medium confidence; it was read with the complete chain and compared to the i-1 indices below. No capital N was found.

Three insertions are present: str. before croissante, the quantifier ∀i above the cancelled preliminary clause, and par récurrence after définir. The latter’s long leader hooks before une. The isolated curved stroke at the upper-right of the recurrence crop is the preceding-line comma after I minus I_{i-1}, not a parenthesis belonging to the insertion.

The cancelled preliminary minimality clause ends in minim., whereas the following live clause writes minimaux across a line break. The baseline replacement I_i minus I_{i-1} is not itself an above-line addition.

Remark 3 proposes replacing the indexed family of pairs by a cylindrical stratification and describes the earlier case by the ordered set written P(Λ) with an open-circle superscript. The relative verb remains uncertain. The prose parenthesis opened before le cas has no closing partner on this leaf; none is supplied.

The heavily cancelled heading and the standalone cancelled symbol remain doubtful. H also marks those spans as unreadable, so no positive lexical recovery is claimed or counted for either. The final cancelled word is physically present and omitted by H, even though its lettering remains unresolved.

The three dots after X_{I_0} are separate. In the filtration chain the compressed ellipsis is drawn as two horizontal traces, one longer; no extra inclusion sign occurs between I_1 and those traces. The existing conventional ellipsis encoding is retained without inventing a separate sign.

H’s editorial notes and typographical wrappers are not treated as source prose. In particular, emph for the underlined heading, ordinary display-versus-inline syntax, and mathfrak versus mathcal for the same handwritten P do not generate collation rows. Narrowing the alternatives on the last verb alone is not counted as a change to C.

There is no standalone diagram or drawing. The visible long curves are insertion leaders, descenders or punctuation; the heavily marked spans are cancellations. The foliation 36 is thinner than the principal writing, but no attribution to a particular hand is established.

All source images were read directly: one whole-page view and one view of each native half, followed by 15 saved targeted crops. Every saved crop was inspected by this reader and by the editor. No OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used; check_events is intentionally empty.
